# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 37 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 37-38 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_037_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 37

**1** His disciples said: "When will you show yourself to us? When will we get to see you?"

**2** Jesus said: "When you take off your clothes without any shame, throw them on the ground like little children, and stomp on them —

**3** that is when you will see the Son of the Living One, and you will have no fear."

---

**Translation Notes (PNEUMA):**
- "Show yourself to us" — the revelation rendered as Jesus's active showing
- "Throw them on the ground" — the garments cast down; the action is forceful
- "Stomp on them" — "trample" rendered more aggressively
- "Have no fear" — the fearlessness rendered as an achieved state
